correctness.rationale: Full finite proof: an injective/surjective 16-bit feedback map encoding enumerates all 2^16 maps, selecting exactly 2,048 full 32-state orbits. A genuinely different edge-simple Euler-tour enumeration gives the identical canonical cycles. For each of 32 roots per cycle, Duval factorization is cross-checked against definition-level longest Lyndon prefixes with independent checks of the Lyndon property and non-increasing order. The checker ran successfully and verifies both complete frequency tables and extremal witnesses. No infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: An exact complete classification of a canonical factorization invariant for a canonical complete family of universal cycles, with both rooted and per-cycle sharp spectra. The FKM de Bruijn–Lyndon relationship provides a specific motivation: its distinguished concatenation does not control the non-increasing factorization under root changes. The census identifies the 1–16 variation, exactly one Lyndon cut per cycle, and only two maximal rooted cases. This finite naturally motivated invariant is valuable independently of higher-order generalization.
